Build the indicator index DataTable

render_index_table.Rd

Builds a single-column, non-paginated DT::datatable listing every distinct indicator name present in mfi.

Usage

render_index_table(mfi)

Arguments

mfi

Data frame of World Bank indicator values, with an Indicator Name column.

Value

A DT::datatable htmlwidget.

Examples

render_index_table(mfi)
